verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Teams app platform with publishing/validation workflows (ms-teams-docs-7, ms-teams-docs-24) and third-party app integration concepts (connectors, message extensions, bots), implying an app store/marketplace exists, but no direct evidence describes a team-admin browsing/installing prebuilt apps from an app directory UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Teams App Store/admin center app installation flow, screenshots or admin-center guidance for approving/installing third-party apps, and independent confirmation of ease of use for admins.
